findings.text: Defect 3 is reported as "core side fixed", but the core splitter regex is unchanged (core/Task/sentences.js:4 is the old `Prompt.split` line moved into a file). Core already kept "3.5" and "session.json" whole; the regex that splits them is ChatV2Model's (ext/Chat/v2/ChatV2Model.js:86), and it is untouched. So core and chat still number sentences differently. prompt-record.md defect 3 should say plainly that nothing changed in behaviour yet and the whole fix is the one-line ChatV2Model import.

core/Task/sentences.js:1 says the chat's fold "both number a paragraph's sentences with it". That is false today: ChatV2Model does not import it. Reword it to "the chat's fold should import it (defect 3, open)" so the next agent isn't misled.

The task folder prompt-record/ has no task.jsonl or session.jsonl, and the session's index.json and cache.jsonl don't mention it (law 10: index everything you create). A fresh agent has requirements.md and the doc, but no record of the task's state, its owner or its branch merge status. Open the task record and add it to the session.

doc/prompt.md's Prompt field table (lines 14-21) doesn't list the smart seat's `title`/`text`, or the new `text` vs `cleaned` getters (core/Task/Prompt.js:97-100). Only prompt-record.md explains them, so the module's field reference is now stale. Add one row.

`set text(value)` (core/Task/Prompt.js:100) is never reached by replay: replay calls `put` directly (Task.js:561), and `Item.set_one` resolves `text` to a string and also calls `put`. It's harmless, but it's dead code unless a caller assigns `p.text = …`.

Behaviour change: `p.text` now returns the smart seat's refined text instead of the paragraph join. Callers that wanted the cleaned words must use `p.cleaned`. A grep found no outside callers of the Prompt getter, and `trace` was updated to search both (Prompt.js:161).

Tests pass in the worktree (C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/prompt-record, commit f0de5d906): `node Prompt.test.mjs` 15 passed, `node Question.test.mjs` 6 passed, matching requirements item 3. The new "one splitter" test (Prompt.test.mjs:39) would also have passed before this change, so it proves no fix.

findings.text: The new file `core/Task/sentences.js` is not listed in `core/Task/readme.md` or in `doc/prompt.md`. Only prompt-record.md:39 and :47 mention it, so someone reading the readme won't learn the shared splitter exists, and the next agent to fix defect 3 won't find it either (law 10). Add it to the readme's "Prompt and Question" line (readme.md:113) and to the `sentences` row of prompt.md's field table.

Prompt.js:53 says the splitter is "shared with the chat's fold". That is still false, because ChatV2Model.js:87 keeps its own `match(/[^.!?]+…/)` regex. Round 1 corrected the same claim in sentences.js:1, but this second copy was missed. Reword it to "the chat's fold should use it too (prompt-record.md defect 3)".

Round 1's fixes are in commit f2a7bf5d5. Defect 3 now says plainly that nothing has changed in behaviour yet. The sentences.js comment is corrected, prompt.md has a `title`, `text` row, and task.jsonl now records the owner, the branch and the merge status. A fresh agent can pick up from requirements.md plus task.jsonl.

The session's `index.json` still has `children: 0` and `links.task: null`, so the session record doesn't link to the task folder. index.json looks machine-written (it carries cost and wall time), so this belongs to whatever script writes it, not to this task. The checkboxes in requirements.md's "Deliver" list are also left unticked, even though all four are done.
There is a simpler way to write the alias: `static split = split;` would replace the wrapper method at Prompt.js:54. `set text` (Prompt.js:100) is still never called, as round 1 noted.
I re-ran both tests in the worktree at f2a7bf5d5. `node Prompt.test.mjs` passes 15 of 15 and `node Question.test.mjs` passes 6 of 6. That meets requirements item 4.
